purpose: Proposed translations and bounded review evidence only; not canonical resources or acceptance.

source_messages.commons_svg_original_size_unavailable: The SVG does not declare a usable original size. No canvas-based size was substituted.
source_messages.commons_svg_original_size_too_large: The original SVG size exceeds Android bitmap dimensions. No resizing was applied.

semantic_constraints: Preserve unavailable usable declared original size, not merely missing SVG or zero size.
Preserve absence of any canvas-based substitute; do not claim the canvas size changed.
Preserve the Android bitmap dimension limit, not memory budget, file bytes, or SVG byte limit.
Preserve no resizing at all; do not introduce automatic-only or shrinking-only scope.
Retain SVG and Android technical identities.
